system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Conspiracy distraction meta-narrative",
    "detail": "Story suggests Epstein files interest 'plummeted after war on Iran launched', implying conflict serves as deliberate distraction from scandals.",
    "debias": "Avoid suggesting conflicts are deliberately timed to distract from unrelated domestic scandals without substantial evidence of coordination.",
    "date_added": "2026-03-30",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "No one in the market has ever seen the outages we are now suffering from",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/3/30/oil-rises-above-116-a-barrel-as-iran-accuses-us-of-preparing-invasion",
    "unbiased_text": "Market participants described the current supply disruptions as among the most significant in recent years",
    "detail_items": [
      "Story suggests Epstein files interest 'plummeted after war on Iran launched', implying conflict serves as deliberate distraction from scandals."
    ]
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Anti-war voice platforming",
    "detail": "Features first-person American anti-war sentiment ('We, the American people, have had enough of endless wars') as representative perspective.",
    "debias": "Balance anti-war voices with diverse American public opinion including those supporting military action or conflicted views.",
    "date_added": "2026-03-30",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "The only way to avoid grave economic consequences is to end the war as soon as possible.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2026/3/23/why-the-oil-and-gas-price-shock-from-the-iran-war-wont-just-fade-away",
    "unbiased_text": "Analysts note that an end to hostilities would reduce economic disruption, though other policy options such as strategic reserve releases and production increases could also mitigate effects.",
    "detail_items": [
      "Features first-person American anti-war sentiment ('We, the American people, have had enough of endless wars') as representative perspective."
    ]
  }
]
